chunks: And from a letter of him (peace be upon him) to Abu Musa al-Ash'ari, in reply regarding the matter of the two arbitrators; Sa'id ibn Yahya al-Umawi mentioned it in his book Al-Maghazi.

key_terms.أَمْرِ الْحَكَمَيْنِ: The matter of the two arbitrators

ai.seo_question: What is the source and subject of Imam Ali's letter to Abu Musa al-Ash'ari regarding the two arbitrators?
ai.summary: This correspondence addresses the pivotal theological and political crisis of the Battle of Siffin, where Imam Ali (AS) accepted arbitration to preserve the Muslim community despite his preference for divine judgment. It highlights the tension between pragmatic political necessity and jurisprudential integrity, a central theme in Shia historiography regarding the legitimacy of Ali's caliphate. The citation of Sa'id ibn Yahya al-Umawi underscores the early transmission of this event within the broader narrative of Islamic civil wars (Fitna).
